wholePhysicalScope: Named OpenStreetMap building polygon, the dimensions and exterior description from the Historic American Buildings Survey, and exact native Qualla exterior photographs.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the street gates, hipped shingle roof, upper weatherboarding and east gallery.
limitations: The roof ridge and exterior joinery heights are proportional estimates. The model represents the standing house and its attached outdoor bays. Small fittings, flags and the separate museum buildings are outside the model.
